title: Domain IAM
subtitle: Manage users, project access and login methods in your current domain.
denied: Management authority for the current domain is not verified.
domainMismatch: The server domain does not match your signed-in domain. Sign in again.
domainHelp: Changes apply only to the current working domain. Use the domain switcher to select another domain; your account's home domain stays unchanged.
name: Name
passwordHelp: Passwords are cleared after each save attempt. Leave blank when editing to retain the current password.
ownershipUnique: One explicit direct owner is verified. Change ownership only through an explicit transfer.
ownershipConflict: Existing ownership conflict: multiple owners or group/inherited ownership. No owner is selected or revoked automatically. Explicit administrator resolution is required.
ownershipMissing: A single direct owner could not be verified. Default remains protected; for an ordinary project, an administrator must review an interrupted transfer or existing ownership state.
transferUnresolved: A previous native ownership operation is running or has an unknown outcome. A system administrator must explicitly confirm that all original requests have stopped and reconcile the operation before it can run again. Refresh alone never permits replay.
transferSettled: A system administrator confirmed that the previous native requests have stopped. Only when the server permits it may you explicitly resume transfer to the original target. The target cannot be changed.
transferOperationDetails: Operation {id} · previous user {from} → target user {to} · stage {stage}
transferConfirm: Transfer ownership of {project} to {user}? The previous ownership grant is revoked before the new owner is assigned.
eligibleUsersHelp: Choose only enabled users joined to this project's domain. Their home identity domain may be different.
safeDeleteHelp: Default cannot be deleted. Deletion requires both project-creation authority and current sole ownership, or domain-manager authority. Resources, child projects or unavailable checks block deletion; the server rechecks immediately before deleting.
mutationUncertain: The change outcome could not be confirmed. Nothing is automatically retried. Refresh to inspect the current state before explicitly trying again.
projectCreatorsHelp: Grant or revoke direct project_creator access for joined users in this domain. Managers create through separate administrative authority. This role alone neither deletes another user's project nor grants ownership. Inherited access cannot be directly revoked here.
creatorPresetMissing: The project_creator preset role is missing. A system administrator must explicitly apply the role presets. No role or grant is automatically created.
grantCreatorConfirm: Grant {user} direct project-creation access in the current domain?
revokeCreatorConfirm: Revoke {user}'s direct project-creation access? Group and inherited access remains.
emptyCreators: No users have delegated project-creation access.
personalDomainHelp: Enter a display name of 1–64 characters. Duplicate display names are allowed. Your account stays in its home identity domain when joining other domains.
foreignIdentity: Foreign-home account: manage its profile and password in its identity domain.
defaultMembership: Default reader membership is granted automatically.
rolesHelp: Edit direct grants only. Group/inherited authority and existing ownership remain. Change ownership only through the explicit transfer above; the server enforces delegation ceilings.
activeDeletionHelp: Deleting the active project selects a fresh domain scope. If its native token is revoked, you must sign in again with your original account. Pending invitations and connection requests are retained.
deletedRescopeFailed: The project was deleted, but a fresh session scope could not be issued. Sign in again with your original account. Deletion is not retried.
removeConfirm: Remove all direct project grants for {user}? Group and inherited access remains.
inviteHelp: Invitations are created only after email delivery succeeds. Existing accounts accept using their original home-domain identity; passwords and home domains stay unchanged. Without an additional project, the user still receives reader access to this domain's Default.
revokeConfirm: Revoke the invitation for {email}? Its invitation link will stop working.
policyHelp: Email restrictions apply to every login method. The server rejects changes that leave no usable login method.
smtpMissing: Email delivery is not configured. Invitations and verified signup require operator SMTP configuration.
loginDomainsHelp: Separate with commas or spaces. An empty list leaves email domains unrestricted.
signupDomainsHelp: Separate with commas or spaces. Signup policy applies together with login policy.
federationHelp: Requires a real operator-configured Keystone IdP and protocol. Saving does not establish external federation or prove a successful login.
disableProviderConfirm: Disable {name}? The policy applies to subsequent logins and refreshes.
deleteProviderConfirm: Delete {name}? New logins through this provider will no longer be available.
secretKeepHelp: Leave blank to keep the existing secret. Entered secrets are cleared after a save attempt and never displayed again.
secretHelp: Secrets are write-only and cleared after each save attempt.
githubEndpointsHelp: Leave blank for standard GitHub endpoints. For Enterprise, enter operator-approved HTTPS endpoints.
callbackHelp: Register /auth/callback under the operator-configured frontend address as the redirect URI.
scopesHelp: OIDC requires openid and email; GitHub requires the user:email scope.
verificationHelp: A provider becomes a verified login method only after successful complete Keystone login. Security edits clear verification; enable password login before changing the sole verified provider.
federationTokenHelp: Choose the token type accepted by your actual Keystone integration. This setting does not establish federation.
recoveryHelp: Operations interrupted while creating accounts or granting roles. Recovery reverts only the account and roles this operation newly created, and completes only after the server verifies they are gone.
recoverConfirm: Revert the operation for {email}? Only the account and roles it newly created are removed.
errorInvalidInput: Some input is invalid. Check each field.
errorLastLoginMethod: This is the last usable login method. Enable password login or verify another provider first.
errorRevisionConflict: It was changed elsewhere first. Refresh and save again.
errorSmtpNotConfigured: Signup cannot be enabled because email delivery is not configured.
errorSignupDomainsRequired: Enabling signup requires allowed email domains.
errorSignupDomainNotAllowed: Signup domains must be within the allowed login domains.
errorInvalidEmailDomain: Invalid email domain. Enter an exact host name without @.
errorInvalidScopes: Required scopes are missing. OIDC needs openid and email; GitHub needs user:email.
errorUnsafeUrl: Unsafe or unresolvable URL. Use a public HTTPS address.
errorProviderNotFound: Login provider not found. Refresh the list.
errorProviderNameConflict: A provider with this name already exists.
errorKindImmutable: The provider connection type cannot be changed.
errorIdpNotFound: Keystone IdP or protocol not found.
errorIdpDomainMismatch: The Keystone IdP belongs to another domain.
errorClientSecretReplacementRequired: Enter a new client secret to change the issuer or token destination.
errorUnsupportedTokenAuthMethod: The provider does not support this token endpoint authentication method.
errorUnavailable: The service is temporarily unavailable. Try again shortly.
